info.name: Verdix POS - Sta. Lucia Integration
info.description:
Requests against Verdix POS's OWN API routes for the Sta. Lucia mall Sale Consolidator integration (EOD + hourly). None of these call the mall directly — they call our Next.js server, which in turn talks to the mall using the credentials stored in the `external_apis` table.

Set `baseUrl` to wherever the Verdix dev/prod server is running (default: http://localhost:3000). Set `apiId` to the id of the `external_apis` row configured with `provider = 'sta_lucia'` — check with:

```sql
SELECT id, name, enabled, api_endpoint FROM external_apis WHERE provider = 'sta_lucia';
```

item.name: 1. Test connection (SAFE — read-only, never writes to the mall)

request.description: Logs in, calls get-transactions, logs out. Builds a sample payload for inspection but NEVER posts it — safe to run repeatedly, including against production credentials, without creating any record on the mall's side. Use this first to confirm credentials/connectivity before trying a real send.

item.name: 2. Send hourly sales (WRITES to the mall)

request.description: Submits sale_type: true (hourly) for the given hour, aggregated store-wide from sales_transactions. Omit hourStart to submit the most recently CLOSED hour automatically. WARNING: this is a real submission — the mall records it. Re-running for an hour that already succeeded is a safe no-op (returns skipped: true), but a first-time send is real.

item.name: 3. Send EOD Z-reading (WRITES to the mall)

request.description: Submits sale_type: false (end-of-day) for the given Z-reading. Leave zReadingId empty to submit the most recent one. WARNING: real submission, same as above. A Z-reading that already succeeded is a safe no-op.

query.description: Swap to STA_LUCIA_SALES for EOD logs, or remove this param entirely for all types.

request.description: Read-only. Shows submission history (success/failed/pending) with the exact payload and response for each attempt.
Manually retry one failed row (works for both STA_LUCIA_SALES and STA_LUCIA_HOURLY_SALES). Get the log id from request #4's response. WARNING: real submission if it succeeds.

item.name: 6. Trigger the retry sweep manually (dev only)

request.description: Runs one pass of the background retry sweep on demand, instead of waiting for the 2-minute cron. Only exists in non-production builds (404s in production). Picks up any pending/failed row for a config with on_error_action = 'retry'.
